mainEntity.name: What is a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary suite addition involves expanding your home to create a new, dedicated private living area. This typically includes a larger bedroom, an en-suite bathroom, and often a walk-in closet or sitting area. It can be built as a horizontal extension on the ground floor or a vertical addition above an existing structure, depending on lot size, zoning regulations, and structural feasibility. The goal is to enhance comfort, privacy, and overall home value.
